title: A Letter for the Parish
author: Lena Thackeray
blurb: Silas Nystrom, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
